data.long_description:
BelAir at The Trump Estates unveils an exclusive selection of villas, marked by striking facades designed in collaboration with some of the world’s foremost architects. Inside, each villa features carefully curated interiors that exude luxury and sophistication. These residences are masterfully designed to integrate with the natural environment, offering spacious, light-filled living spaces that create a perfect balance between modern elegance and serene surroundings.

The development is located within the large community of Damac Hills, adjacent to the renowned Trump International Dubai Golf Club. There are 4,000,000 sq ft of parkland offering a variety of themed recreational and sporting areas including tranquil gardens and lakes, skate park, stables, football pitch and tennis courts. The Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club is 10 minutes away and Dubai Autodrome, Miracle Garden, Global Village and IMG World are 15 minutes away. Within BelAir at The Trump Estates, residents can also find a host of recreational amenities.
Among them:
- Swimming pool
- Barbecue area
- Children's playground
- Gym
- Jacuzzi

Finance is available on this property through Premier Property Finance. Call us on +97143233609 for a free consultation.
